args.title: Bellwether Office Newsletter Summary – Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a major cost driver for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs reduced handling costs by roughly 20% (one-fifth), highlighting the value of centralized logistics for returns processing.
- Companion piece (subscriber content): Reselling returned items quickly—within 10 days—preserves most of the product's original margin, underscoring the importance of speed in the resale pipeline.
